_comment: S-07a starter candidates (DEC-01, DEC-52, RS-09), in order of preference. Repository, revision, file, size and sha256 come from Handy's catalog (src-tauri/src/catalog/catalog.json) at the quant below; a test checks every id is there. `unusableFor` lists languages RS-09 measured as unusable on that model (whisper-base Dutch: 63.6 % WER). The first candidate usable for every language the user speaks is downloaded first; with none, the first usable for the first language; else the last resort.
